NAVIGATOR trial (NEJM 2021) used treatment policy estimand — exacerbations counted regardless of ICS changes. This pragmatic design is WHY it demonstrated efficacy across all endotypes, including low-eosinophil patients. The estimand choice is inseparable from the broad label.
QUEST/LIBERTY asthma trials used treatment policy for annualized exacerbation rate. Ph3 COPD (AERIFY) uses treatment policy. Positive Phase 3 COPD data for itepekimab in ex-smokers.
RESCUE-COPD used treatment policy estimand for exacerbation reduction — counts events regardless of background therapy changes. Positive exacerbation data; HF indication adds cardiovascular angle.
Anti-ST2/IL-33R; Phase 3 asthma and COPD using treatment policy. Complements QX031N (TSLP×IL-33) strategic rationale — Roche acquiring dual pathway blockade.
Long-acting anti-TSLP; Ph1 safety/PK ongoing. BSI-502 (TSLP×IL-4R bispecific) also in Ph1. Estimand for efficacy studies TBD — expected to follow tezepelumab treatment policy standard.
IL-4Rα × TSLP bispecific; Phase 1 asthma and atopic dermatitis. No efficacy estimand defined yet. Potential out-licensing of global rights.
TSLP × IL-11 bispecific — IL-11 angle unique for fibrotic indications. Phase 1 safety only; IPF indication may require composite or hypothetical estimand given high dropout rates.
Anti-TSLP monoAb in Phase 2; licensed to Windward $970M. Phase 2 asthma exacerbation endpoint expected to use treatment policy. COPD Ph2 design pending.
